comment: PltM is involved pyoluteorin biosynthesis pathway. It is a bona fide phenol-halogenase with an extraordinary substrate and halide scope, which does not accept tryptophan. Dihalogenation of substrates is much more likely. Nonproduct: Fluorinated product. Auxiliary enzyme flavin reductase not in genecluster.
